description: Golden vectors for the canonical-json-v1 serializer. Each vector's 'input' is materialized to a Python value (JSON numbers parse to int/float exactly as written; '$$'-prefixed marker objects stand for values JSON cannot express: $$nonfinite, $$bytes_hex, $$duplicate_keys + $$raw_text) and 'expected' is the exact canonical output text, compared as UTF-8 bytes. Keys sort by UTF-8 byte sequence; strings keep their original code points with minimal escaping; separators are fixed; finite floats use RFC 8785 (ECMAScript Number::toString) shortest-round-trip formatting; non-finite floats, byte strings, and duplicate-key objects use the fixed typed wrappers.

vectors.name: integer-arbitrary-precision
vectors.note: Python int values serialize as exact integer literals and never route through double formatting.

vectors.name: integer-negative-zero-json
vectors.note: JSON -0 parses to integer 0; there is no negative integer zero.

vectors.name: float-negative-zero
vectors.note: RFC 8785: -0 normalizes to 0.

vectors.name: float-integral
vectors.note: Integral floats render without a decimal point.

vectors.name: float-decimal-threshold-1e20
vectors.note: ECMAScript keeps decimal notation below 1e21.

vectors.name: float-scientific-threshold-1e21
vectors.note: ECMAScript switches to scientific notation at 1e21; the exponent carries an explicit +.

vectors.name: float-decimal-threshold-1e-6
vectors.note: ECMAScript keeps decimal notation down to 1e-6.

vectors.name: float-scientific-threshold-1e-7
vectors.note: ECMAScript switches to scientific notation below 1e-6; exponents never carry leading zeros.

vectors.name: float-shortest-digits-at-decimal-threshold
vectors.note: Shortest round-trip digits expanded to decimal notation below 1e21.

vectors.name: string-escapes
vectors.note: Quote, backslash, and the C0 short forms escape as in JSON.

vectors.name: string-control-nul
vectors.note: Controls without a short form escape as \u00xx with lowercase hex.

vectors.name: string-unicode-preserved
vectors.note: Original code points pass through unescaped as UTF-8; U+2028/U+2029 are not escaped.

vectors.name: string-lone-surrogate-escaped
vectors.note: Lone surrogates escape (lowercase hex) so the output stays valid UTF-8.

vectors.name: bytes-blob
vectors.note: SQLite BLOBs and invalid UTF-8 wrap as standard base64 under $bytes.

vectors.name: bytes-valid-utf8-still-wrapped
vectors.note: Byte strings stay wrapped even when they happen to decode as UTF-8.

vectors.name: duplicate-keys-ordered-pairs-with-raw-text
vectors.note: Every occurrence is retained in original order alongside the original raw text.

vectors.name: object-key-order-utf8-bytes-z-before-é
vectors.note: Keys sort by UTF-8 byte sequence: 'z' (0x7A) sorts before 'é' (U+00E9, bytes C3 A9).

vectors.name: object-key-order-utf8-bytes-not-utf16-units
vectors.note: UTF-8 byte order puts U+FFFF (EF BF BF) before U+1F600 (F0 9F 98 80); a UTF-16 code-unit sort would diverge here.

vectors.name: object-null-value
vectors.note: SQLite NULL is JSON null; absent columns are omitted entirely (compare object-empty).

vectors.name: object-marker-key-passthrough
vectors.note: Ordinary data whose keys collide with a wrapper marker serializes identically to the wrapper; markers are self-describing, not unambiguous.

vectors.name: separators-fixed
vectors.note: No whitespace: ',' between members, ':' after keys.
